page_title: LYO 2-1 BRE | Lyon v Brest 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
90+4' Orel Mangala (Lyon) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Remi Himbert will replace Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
90' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Hans Hateboer.
89' Substitution. Endrick did his best and is replaced by Adam Karabec (Lyon).
87' 2 - 1 Goal! Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 2:1.
86' What was Abner Vinicius (Lyon) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
85' Brest will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
85' Lyon are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
81' Kenny Lala will be replaced by Luc Zogbe (Brest).
81' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) replaces Bradley Locko.

78' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Orel Mangala (Lyon) comes onto the pitch so that Tanner Tessmann can be given a rest.
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ainsley Maitland-Niles as he is replaced by Khalis Merah (Lyon).
70' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
69' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Ludovic Ajorque and he is replaced by Daouda Guindo (Brest).
69' Substitution. Kamory Doumbia (Brest) in, Lucas Tousart out.
66' A more precise finish was all that was needed for this set play to have been a success. Endrick (Lyon) received the ball far out and fired a projectile which went yards over the bar.
64' Endrick (Lyon) picks up the rebound and shoots. The goalkeeper was ready and denies his effort with a fine save.
63' The goal by Lyon won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
62' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Lyon can stand using VAR.
60' Goal! Pavel Sulc (Lyon) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 3:0.
60' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Gregoire Coudert is prepared to thwart his effort.
57' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Remy Labeau Lascary is replaced by Pathe Mboup (Brest).
57' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) stretches for the loose ball inside the box and rifles a volley just wide of the right post.
55' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
53' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
50' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Abner Vinicius (Lyon) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
47' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) has tested the patience of referee Romain Lissorgue and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Romain Lissorgue has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' A cross from Joris Chotard (Brest) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45+2' 2 - 0 An excellent first touch by Abner Vinicius (Lyon), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
45+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

44' A sweet pass finds Endrick (Lyon) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Gregoire Coudert is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
41' 1 - 0 Pavel Sulc (Lyon) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
39' Lovely run from Endrick (Lyon). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
37' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
37' The ball is cleared after Pavel Sulc (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
35' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
32' Endrick (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
27' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' Lyon are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
19' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Romain Del Castillo (Brest) has to leave the pitch!

19' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Romain Del Castillo (Brest), but referee Romain Lissorgue must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Romain Del Castillo (Brest) was quite harsh and Romain Lissorgue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) takes the corner with a short pass.
15' Endrick (Lyon) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Lyon have a corner.
14' The ball is cleared after Afonso Moreira (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
10' Endrick (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
8' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
6' A precise low pass is received by Endrick (Lyon), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
5' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' A cross into the box from Afonso Moreira (Lyon) is cleared.
2' Endrick (Lyon) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lyon will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Romain Lissorgue.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
